id: 加密订阅文件已保存。请单独传递密码。
en: Encrypted file saved. Share the password separately.

id: 只传订阅和节点，不会覆盖已有订阅、分流或设置。
en: Only subscriptions and nodes are transferred. Existing subscriptions, routes and settings stay unchanged.

id: 文件包含已有订阅，未导入任何内容。
en: This file contains an existing subscription. Nothing was added.

id: 无法打开订阅文件，请核对密码和文件。
en: Cannot open the subscription file. Check the password and the file.

id: 未取得完整的第三方安全标签
en: The provider did not return a full set of labels.

id: 未能导出，请检查所选位置和可用空间。
en: Export failed. Check the destination and available space.

id: 未能添加，请重新打开文件预览。
en: Nothing was added. Open the file again to review it.

id: 离线订阅文件不能下载节点集合
en: An offline subscription file cannot download nodes.

id: 安装包已验证，可以直接安装。
en: APK verified. You can install it now.

id: 请在系统设置中允许 Weave 安装应用，然后返回点「安装更新」。
en: Allow Weave to install apps in system settings, then come back and tap Install update.

id: 正在打开系统安装确认。
安装未完成。可以重试，或保存安装包后手动安装。
en: The update was not installed. Try again, or save the APK and install it yourself.
Routing settings could not be saved

id: 已保存，请重新连接以应用分流设置
en: Saved. Reconnect to apply routing settings

id: 无法读取局域网共享凭据
en: Could not load LAN sharing credentials

id: 仅接管 IPv6，阻止应用 IPv4 流量并停用应用绕过
en: Route IPv6, block app IPv4 traffic, and disable app bypass

id: 已选择仅 IPv6；IPv4 实际阻断情况仍需核验
en: IPv6-only mode is selected. Check actual IPv4 blocking separately.

id: IPv4 已在运行规则中拒绝
加密，仅解析 DoH/DoT 服务器域名
en: Encrypted, resolves only DoH/DoT server names

id: 已选择加密引导 DNS，只解析加密 DNS 服务的地址
en: Encrypted bootstrap DNS is selected for resolving encrypted resolver addresses.

id: 在 Android 的 VPN 设置中选择 Weave 和始终开启。可同时启用无 VPN 时阻止连接。
en: In Android VPN settings, select Weave and turn on Always-on. You can also block connections without VPN.
Try to reconnect after reboot and unlock

id: 系统没有始终开启选项时，可尝试恢复上次连接。手动断开后不会恢复。系统限制重连时，也不会阻止其他网络流量。
en: If Always-on is unavailable, try to restore the last connection. A manual disconnect cancels it. Other traffic remains allowed if Android prevents reconnecting.

id: 让同一 Wi-Fi 或热点下的设备用这台手机的默认出口。接收端可选择 HTTP 或 SOCKS5，并填写这台手机的地址、端口和凭据。
en: Let devices on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot use this phone’s default route. On the other device, choose HTTP or SOCKS5 and enter this phone’s address, port and credentials.

id: 在接收设备上测试代理连通性
en: Test the proxy from the receiving device

id: 连接 Weave 后才会监听代理端口
en: Connect Weave to open the proxy port

id: 在手机 Wi-Fi 详情查看 IP。使用热点时，可在接收端查看网关地址。
en: Find the IP in the phone’s Wi-Fi details. For a hotspot, check the gateway address on the other device.

id: 在可信局域网使用。代理认证没有加密局域网链路。用完请关闭共享。
en: Use a trusted local network. Proxy sign-in leaves the local link unencrypted. Turn off sharing when done.

id: 检测使用当前物理网络，只向受测 DNS 发送 example.com
en: The test uses your current physical network and sends only example.com to each tested DNS service.

id: 耗时包括加密连接和 DNS 回包。只有收到有效地址才算通过。
en: Time includes the encrypted connection and DNS response. A valid address is required to pass.
No network is available for testing

id: 每行一个加密 DNS 地址，最多 6 个。支持 DoH、DoT 和 DoQ。
en: Enter up to six encrypted DNS addresses, one per line. DoH, DoT and DoQ are supported.

id: 通过 QUIC 加密解析
链路中不能重复使用节点
en: A node can appear only once in a chain

id: 链路节点数量超出限制
en: The chain has too many nodes
